purpose: Thematic Catholic Biblical Correspondences compendium; never insert in Historia Salutis narration

source.upstream_description: Catholic Bible cross-reference exports: historical Douay apparatus plus authored NT/deuterocanonical allusion candidates. Original exports are not independently re-creatable from public upstream.

license_notes.douay: Upstream claims CC0 for transcribed historical Douay marginal reference addresses; retain original provenance
license_notes.na27: Upstream labels authored links uncopyrightable facts; theological classifications and accuracy not endorsed here

historical_witness.note: Original-print marginal text retained; modern reference coordinates may have chapter-boundary shifts.

douay.description: Historical Douay-Rheims marginal references as mapped by upstream

na27.description: Modern authored deuterocanonical/allusion leads labelled na27 by upstream; NOT automatic proof from the NA27 critical apparatus

normalization.book_ids: Upstream 73-book spine identifiers, not automatically mapped to Ad Orientem book registry
normalization.chapter_target_rule: When target_scope=chapter, preserve raw_to_address and compare the chapter number against the original printed marginal reference before resolving; BOOK.N.1 is often an upstream chapter anchor, NOT a verified verse-1 reference. Do not discard target suffixes at edition boundaries.
normalization.unreviewed_weight_rule: Weights are preserved opaque upstream metadata; not theological confidence scores.
normalization.chapter_target_exception_rule: Four records have chapter scope but non-.1 target addresses, apparently at historical/modern versification boundaries. Hold for edition-specific adjudication; never silently coerce to chapter or verse.
